questions.stem: How does the structure of the glomerular capillaries help with ultrafiltration?

options.text: They have fenestrations (tiny pores) that allow small molecules to pass through
They have thick walls to withstand high pressure
They contain valves to prevent backflow of filtrate
They are surrounded by muscle cells that squeeze blood through

questions.explanation: The glomerular capillaries have tiny pores (fenestrations) in their walls that allow small molecules like water, glucose, and urea to pass through while retaining blood cells and large proteins.
